params.name: service
params.description: The service name to filter traces by.

params.name: operation
params.description: The operation name to filter traces by.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags to filter by in JSON format, e.g. {"http.status_code":"200"}.

params.name: minDuration
params.description: Minimum trace duration filter, specified as a duration string (e.g. 1.2s, 100ms, 500us).

params.name: maxDuration
params.description: Maximum trace duration filter, specified as a duration string (e.g. 1.2s, 100ms, 500us).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of traces to return.

params.name: lookback
params.description: How far back to search for traces, specified as a duration string (e.g. 1h, 2d). Only used if start and end are not set.

items.docs: Search for traces matching the specified query parameters. Returns a list of traces filtered by service, operation, tags, duration, and time range.

params.name: traceID
params.description: The trace ID in hexadecimal format (16 or 32 hex characters).

params.name: raw
params.description: Return raw trace data without post-processing.

items.docs: Retrieve a single trace by its unique trace identifier.
